Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
The Full-of-Foils bundle contains one of each foil drop available in the April Superdrop. If you hold them up to the light, you’ll see that they glisten beautifully—much like the scales of a salmon as it careers through the air after getting absolutely catapulted out of a river by the powerful forepaws of a hungry bear. Nature is beautiful, mysterious, and just a little bit scary. This all-foil bundle is all three of those things, but also something you can own if you buy it before the sale ends. You can’t own nature, man. It’s not for sale. This bundle? For sale. Know the difference. Buy the bundle.
